title: AAPS 2.8.2: Medtronic history crash - Suspends entries: Value 60 for secondOfMinute must be in the range [0,59]
symptom: While pulling Medtronic history, AAPS 2.8.2 crashes and restarts. The log shows an error processing Suspends entries: Value 60 for secondOfMinute must be in the range [0,59].
cause: The pump history contains entries with invalid date/time values, such as secondOfMinute=60 or dayOfMonth=0, which cause a crash when parsing.
fix: The problem was found and fixed in a pull request (#477). A hotfix branch based on master containing all 3 medtronic fixes was created.
evidence_quote: Found the problem and fixed. Pull request is opened: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/477
